reason: I want to examine the channel grains, and collecting them in a sample jar is a natural first step.
expectation: I expect to collect a channel sample that I can inspect, perhaps with the hand lens.

alternatives.reason: Exposing the rock surface also matches a goal, but I want to start with the channel sample.

effect: The jar collected channel sediment, so I can now inspect it with the hand lens.
reaction: The result was straightforward; I’m curious what the grains will show.
reason: Examining the sediment directly advances the goal of looking at the channel grains.
expectation: I expect the lens to reveal features of the grains, though I don’t know what they will suggest.

alternatives.reason: The rock ledge is also a goal, but I want to finish examining the sample first.

effect: The rounded grains suggest wear and movement, but do not establish what carried them. The channel goal is complete, leaving the rock ledge to examine.
reaction: I appreciated the distinction between evidence of movement and its unknown cause.
reason: Using the hammer on the ledge is the only available combination and matches the remaining goal of exposing fresh rock.
expectation: I expect to expose or collect a fresh rock surface, though I don’t yet know what it will reveal.

effect: The hammer produced a layered rock chip, and its rough face needs smoothing before I can examine the grains inside.
reaction: The next step is clear, and I’m curious how the rock’s grains are arranged.
reason: The abrasive pad is the only available combination and should expose the chip’s internal surface.
expectation: I expect a smoother rock face that reveals its grain arrangement, though I don’t know what it will show.

effect: The smoothed chip revealed fine bands around coarser grains and a pale vein crossing them, completing the rock examination without establishing how those features formed.
reaction: I’m curious about the vein and what the arrangement might record.

mostWorthwhile.text: Examining the channel grains was most worthwhile: their rounded edges suggested wear and movement, while the story made clear that this alone does not identify what carried them.

leastWorthwhile.text: Collecting the channel sediment was a straightforward preparatory action with little to discover on its own.

surprise.text: The fresh rock face had fine bands curving around coarser grains, with a pale vein cutting across them. I did not expect that combination of features.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; collecting and inspecting the sediment, then exposing and smoothing the rock, each had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The rounded grains and crosscutting vein leave me curious about what further observations might reveal about the landscape.
